subject.title: fix: deleting a session leaves its trajectory artifacts orphaned on disk

question: Should reset preserve trajectory runtime and pointer artifacts for the configured archive-retention window, with this PR becoming canonical over https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94593?
rationale: Preservation improves incident forensics but deliberately retains sensitive tool arguments and results, and two viable branches implement that policy through different ownership boundaries.

options.title: Approve unified retention here
options.body: Use this PR for deletion, reset, writer races, and retention, then retire or rebase the overlapping reset-specific PR.

options.title: Keep reset-specific branch
options.body: Narrow this PR to deletion and writer safety and leave reset retention to the existing reset-focused PR.

options.title: Do not retain on reset
options.body: Remove reset tombstoning and preserve destructive reset cleanup if maintainers reject the sensitive-data retention tradeoff.

recommendation.title: Approve unified retention here
recommendation.body: Use this PR for deletion, reset, writer races, and retention, then retire or rebase the overlapping reset-specific PR.
